datasets.name: Digital Elevation Model (DEM) of Chongyi County

methods.name: Multi-scale segmentation (MSS) method
methods.summary: The MSS method is a bottom-up, region-merging technique that merges adjacent grid units based on spectral and shape features (terrain aspect and shaded relief) to form slope units. It uses an improved trial-and-error method to determine scale, shape, and compactness parameters based on landslide morphological features, followed by vector analysis in GIS for optimization.
methods.verbatim: To overcome this problem, the innovative multi-scale segmentation (MSS) method is proposed for extracting slope units. ... All tests are run in the eCognition Developer 8.7 software package (Flanders et al. 2003).

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are not referenced or linked. The custom multi-scale segmentation method code is not provided via a repository or persistent link.
